/bin/bash -lc 'compare() {
  name="$1"
  shift
  exec_output=$(/workspace/dataset/test6_executable "$@" 2>&1)
  exec_code=$?
  node_output=$(node /output/test6.mjs "$@" 2>&1)
  node_code=$?
  normalized_exec_output=${exec_output//test6_executable/test6.mjs}
  if [ "$exec_code" -ne "$node_code" ] || [ "$normalized_exec_output" != "$node_output" ]; then
    printf '"'FAIL %s\\n' \""'$name"
    printf '"'EXEC(%s):\\n%s\\n' \""'$exec_code" "$normalized_exec_output"
    printf '"'NODE(%s):\\n%s\\n' \""'$node_code" "$node_output"
    return 1
  fi
  printf '"'PASS %s\\n' \""'$name"
}
